title: Theory Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear: Sculpted Minimalism at NYU
text:
Theory's Spring 2027 collection, showcased at New York Fashion Week, presents a vision of 'sculpted minimalism'. The fashion house reimagines classic wardrobe staples with a modern, architectural twist. The collection features clean lines, unexpected textures, and a neutral color palette dominated by whites, greys, and browns, embodying a sophisticated and understated aesthetic.
